## Catalog requirements

Course | Title | Credits
Select 6 credits of Japanese language courses: | 6
JAPN202 | Intermediate Japanese II (6 credits)
JAPN301 | Advanced Japanese I (6 credits)
JAPN302 | Advanced Japanese II (6 credits)
JAPN311 | Traditional Japanese Language and Culture
JAPN401 | Readings in Modern Japanese Literature (3 credits)
JAPN402 | Readings in Japanese Cultural Studies (3 credits)
JAPN407 | The Art of Translation
JAPN499 | Directed Study in Japanese (3 credits)
Select one Japanese linguistics course: | 3
JAPN421
JAPN422
JAPN428 | Seminar in Japanese Discourse and Conversation Analysis
JAPN438 | Topics in Japanese Pragmatics
Select one Japanese literature/cultural studies course: | 3
JAPN221
JAPN314
JAPN315 | Reading Japanese Empire
JAPN316 | Women and Japanese Literature: Japanese Literature in Translation
JAPN325 | Modern Japanese Literature and Film (In Translation)
JAPN424 | Japan From the Margins
JAPN425 | The Atomic Bomb in Literature and Memory
JAPN498 | Special Topics in Japanese Studies
Select one additional 3 credit course from the lists above. | 3
Total Credits | 15
At least nine of the fifteen hours must be at the 3xx or 4xx level.
Students must receive a "C-" or better in all courses used for the minor.
An overall GPA of 2.0 in the minor is required for graduation.
No more than 6 of the 15 credits toward the minor may be taken at an institution other than UMCP.

This 15-credit minor recognizes students who have undertaken a concentrated study of the language, literature/culture, and linguistics of Japan.
Program Requirements
Prerequisites (18 Credits)
Course # Course Name Credits Prerequisites JAPN101 Elementary Japanese I 6 None JAPN102 Elementary Japanese II 6 JAPN101 JAPN201 Intermediate Japanese I 6 JAPN102
Note: Students with prior experience in Japanese must take the appropriate Foreign Language Placement Test (FLPT) and consult with the Japanese minor advisor.
Minor Requirements (15 Credits)
Japanese Language Acquisition (6 credits) Japanese Linguistics (3 credits) Japanese Literature/Cultural Studies (3 credits)
Notes: At least nine of the 15 hours required for the minor must be at the 300-level or above No more than 6 of the 15 credits toward the minor may be transferred from study abroad.
Declaring a Japanese Minor
To explore or declare a minor, please contact the minor advisor.

Academics
Undergraduate Studies
Minors are an excellent way for students to gain expertise in an area beyond the major. We encourage students to work with their advisors early to incorporate the minor into their Academic Plans.
Applications for all minors remain open until the minor is filled. Students will be taken on a first-come, first-served basis. When you click on the “contact form” below and select the appropriate option on the form, your request will be marked with the date and time. Please keep in mind that any pre-requisites must be completed by the time of application. (Students applying to the Music Performance minor must successfully pass an audition and should contact the advisor through the form below as soon as possible.)
When a minor is listed as CLOSED, it is closed until October 1 in the fall semester or March 1 in the spring semester. You may check this site again at these times. When a minor is listed as WAITLIST, it is closed, but you may put yourself on a waitlist by clicking on "contact form" below and selecting the appropriate option.
